# Does the new EU product liability regime reach your software or product?

> Free EU Product Liability Directive checker: is your software, AI system or product in scope from 9 December 2026, who is liable in the supply chain, what damage is claimable and what to prepare. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
